sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras, 1x Camera Charger.
Morning shift deployed. Ops phone at 5%; guards on standby while charging, available for response calls.
Welfare check at Starbucks. All clear. Patrol down Queen Street with visible presence.
Arrived at Queen Street / Wyndham Street. Checked. All clear.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a street vagrant sleeping in front of the store; staff requested assistance ahead of a scheduled audit.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. Guards asked the POI to move along politely; he moved to the side away from McDonald's property but refused to leave completely as he was aware he was on public space. Presence maintained.
Welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and Mid City Shopping Centre. All clear.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee. No issues.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full walkthrough completed. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no concerns requiring assistance.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments. Welfare check inside Atrium on Elliott heading towards Crowne Plaza Hotel. All clear.
Welfare checks at Mr Barber, City Convenience Store, and AA Insurance. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. A few street persons at Victoria / Federal Street corner but no complaints raised. Welfare checks on area stores. Presence maintained.
Welfare checks along Kingston Street, including The People's Barista, Pizza Hut, and Convenience Store. All clear.
Arrived at Kingston Street / Albert Street. Welfare check at Little Albert's Cafe. All clear.
Arrived at Albert Street / Wyndham Street. Welfare checks at Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Cafe. All clear.
Walkthrough around Cathedral Church and Federal Square. No issues.
Welfare checks at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at Customs Street / Albert Street intersection. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Welfare checks at Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts. All clear.
Welfare check at OK Gift Shop. All clear.
Arrived at Queens Wharf. Full walkthrough to check for vagrants/encampments. All clear.
Returned to Commercial Bay. Full sweep with welfare checks on stores and cafes. All clear.
Patrol continued. Alpha Route ended and Echo Route commenced.
Welfare checks at Queens Arcade, St Pierre's Sushi, Tuck Shop, Movenpick, and Four Square. All clear.
Arrived at Kiwibank check-in. Scoped thoroughly. All clear.
Welfare checks at The Coffee Club, 77 Convenience Store, Mr Katsu, and Evans Kebabs. All clear.
Welfare check at Giapo (preparing to open). Auckland Harbour Suites, Liquor Store, Smiley Mart Convenience Store, Chargrill, Sienna Cafe, King Made Noodles, and others checked. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no visible issues.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark check-in. Full sweep with welfare checks on stores and static guards. All clear.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male individual who had been inside the bathroom too long; staff requested assistance.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. The POI had come outside and realised his belongings were missing from the front; he became frustrated, yelled, and accused staff. CCTV review showed construction workers cleaning nearby had placed his items in the rubbish bin. Bodycam captured. Guards calmed the situation; the POI apologised and moved along, reminded bathrooms are for customer use only.
Guards left standby and continued patrol.
Response call from The Coffee Club, Wyndham Street, regarding a male sleeping inside and refusing to leave.
Arrived at The Coffee Club. Guards woke the POI and asked him to leave (customer-use only); POI complied. Bodycam captured.
Walkthrough along Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. No issues.
Arrived at Chancery Square check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no visible issues.
Welfare checks on area businesses. All clear.
Welfare checks commenced along Lorne Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street / Wellesley Street. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library. All clear.
Welfare checks at Nando's, Munster Inn, and Queens Food Court. All clear.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive. No visible issues.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full walkthrough completed. No issues.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments. Welfare check inside Atrium on Elliott. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks on all area stores. All clear. Proceeded to HQ for lunch.
Arrived at HQ. Lunch break commenced while preparing for afternoon changeover.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:50 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Debrief completed. Welfare patrol commenced up Queen Street.
Response call from Cotton On regarding a suspicious individual in store.
Arrived at Cotton On. Guards searched the POI and found no items on him. No further issues; individual moved along and patrol resumed.
Response call from Coco Lane advising they had two phones in their possession and requesting they be handed over to HOTC.
Arrived at Coco Lane. Phones taken into HOTC possession. Store advised the phones had been left ~30 minutes prior; no CCTV available. No further issues.
Full sweep through High Street and Chancery Square. No issues. Proceeded towards Commercial Bay.
Vulcan Lane welfare sweep completed. No issues. HOTC contact cards provided to stores.
Fort Street and Gore Street welfare checks completed. No issues.
Commerce Street welfare sweep completed. No issues.
Commercial Bay welfare check completed. All clear. Headed back up Queen Street via Hobson Street towards Victoria Street.
Response call from Mirrou Queen Street requesting assistance with an attempted theft from store.
Arrived at Mirrou. Guards stood by outside while waiting for the POI to exit the changing room.

POI exited and was confronted by the manager, who requested to search her bag; POI refused. The manager attempted to issue and record a verbal trespass, at which point it escalated into an altercation between the POI and manager. HOTC intervened with reasonable force to separate both parties and escorted the POI out of the store.

Police contacted. HOTC issued a verbal trespass to the POI for attempted theft and assault, incident recorded. Guards proceeded to McDonald's Queen Street on a request for assistance with a vagrant causing issues with the venue and patrons.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. POI had already left; staff advised he had been asking patrons and staff for food. Verbal trespass issued and recorded. Patrol resumed.
Welfare sweep completed on Elliott Street and Darby Street. All clear.
Welfare sweep commenced along Queen Street.

Welfare sweep completed; no issues from local stores. During a walkthrough of Elliott Street, guards located an open bottle of alcohol, which was obtained and disposed of. Proceeded to Elliott Stables for welfare check.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables. All clear. Proceeded to Mirrou to assist Police with the earlier incident.
Spoke with Police and provided footage and all available information regarding the Mirrou POI incident.
Response call from Victoria Street Convenience Store regarding two vagrants consuming cannabis in front of the store.
Arrived at Victoria Street Convenience Store. Store owner requested the two vagrants be asked to move elsewhere.
Victoria Street Convenience Store checked. All clear, no further issues. Patrol continued.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a female individual blocking public entry and acting aggressively.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart. Female individual had already left the premises. Presence maintained.
McDonald's Britomart and guard checked. All clear. Proceeded back to office to charge Ops phone.

While returning to the office, encountered a large number of Council guards and two ambulances attending to a vagrant requiring medical assistance after consuming synthetic drugs. Guards stood by in case further assistance was needed.
Ambulance and Council guards left the area. All clear. Proceeded to office.
Approached a female vagrant disturbing the public while returning to office; she was politely told to stop. No further issues.
Approached by a member of the public asking for directions to the nearest gaming lounge. Assistance provided.
Arrived at HQ. Ops phone placed on charge due to low battery.
Call received from a female individual who had lost two phones that were in HOTC possession.
Female individual retrieved her phones. All clear, no further issues.
Afternoon shift concluded. Handover to night shift completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Night shift deployed. Guards stood by inside office to charge Ops phone due to low battery.
Welfare check at Bar101. Presence maintained.
Bar101 checked. All clear. Patrol continued along Queen Street.
Welfare check at Bar101. All clear.
Work phone received a call but it ended quickly. Guards called back but received no answer.
Welfare check with McDonald's Britomart guards. All clear.
Welfare check at Reign & Pour. All clear.
Full sweep around Britomart and Queen Street.
Arrived at Ace Nightclub. Presence maintained.
Welfare check at Ace. All clear.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Full sweep of Victoria Street while heading down to Bar101.
Welfare check at Bar101. No further issues.
Welfare check at Aotea Square. No issues.
Corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield Street checked. All clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street. Presence maintained.
McDonald's Queen Street checked. All clear. Proceeded to HQ for 30-minute break.
Guards stood by at office to charge Ops phone due to low battery.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding two vagrant individuals sleeping inside the store; staff had asked them to leave but they refused.
Guards politely asked the two vagrants to leave the premises. Presence maintained until morning shift handover.

Serious / notable: Mirrou attempted theft / assault / verbal trespass — HOTC used reasonable force to separate parties, Police contacted and later given footage (16:38-18:24, videos on file). McDonald's Queen Street bathroom/missing-belongings dispute resolved via CCTV (11:52). Coffee Club Wyndham Street sleeping POI moved on (12:25). McDonald's Britomart aggressive female, left before arrival (21:30). Synthetic-drug medical incident observed — Council guards + two ambulances (21:43). Coco Lane lost phones returned to owner (22:07). Repeated McDonald's Queen Street vagrant issues.
